title: Composition-compatible open restriction for maps identical over an open
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be an admissible commutative condensed coefficient ring of [sk-def-localizing-closure]. For every scheme $T$ put $D_T=D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T})$, where $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ is the pulled-back ring and the category is the ordinary unbounded module-object derived category [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Use the module direct images and inverse images of [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback], with the coefficient identifications induced by composition of pullbacks from the point and the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow Z$ and $j':U\hookrightarrow Z'$ be quasi-compact open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $h:Z'\to Z$ satisfy $hj'=j$ and $h^{-1}(j(U))=j'(U)$ as open subschemes. There is a canonical natural isomorphism $r_h:j^*Rh_*\xrightarrow{\sim}j'^*$: on a K-injective representative $I$, at $V\to U$, its underived map is the identity on $I(V)$ under $V\times_Z Z'\cong V$. Module actions use the canonical pulled-back coefficient identifications. For $j'':U\hookrightarrow Z''$ and $k:Z''\to Z'$ satisfying the same two conditions, with the compositor $\kappa$ of [lem-sfb-module-derived-compositor-coherence],
$$r_{hk}=(r_k)\circ(r_h Rk_*)\circ(j^*\kappa_{h,k}).$$
For $h=1_Z$, $r_h$ is the identity after the canonical direct-image identity comparison. Properness, scheme-theoretic density, and a field of definition are not assumed.

proof.text: Use the canonical mate witnesses of lem-sfb-identity-open-module-sections. Their homs are identityOpenRestriction by its definition. The section normalization gives the specified formula and their isomorphism structures give underived invertibility. ProjectionGeometry supplies an inverse to the site arrow with exactly its two prescribed projections.

The general cochain normalization of the derived square mate in lem-sbc-unbounded-exact-adjunction-square identifies the actual mate on a K-injective with the ordinary mate. Open inverse image preserves K-injectives. Compose with module_derived_identity_normalization, use naturality and cancel resolution and exact-factorization isomorphisms. This proves the representative formula. Underived invertibility then implies derived invertibility on QI and hence everywhere by naturality along K-injective representative isomorphisms.

Evaluate both composition paths on QI for K-injective I. Direct image preserves K-injectives by exact pullback and its adjunction. Naturality moves the restriction past the k_* resolution comparison. Apply the representative formula twice and module_derived_compositor_normalization. The remaining equality is Q applied degreewise to the underived composition equation of lem-sfb-identity-open-module-sections. Naturality along K-injective representative isomorphisms extends equality to all derived objects.

On QI cancel the exact-restriction factorization. The representative formula and module_derived_identity_normalization reduce the identity law to Q of the underived identity equation of lem-sfb-identity-open-module-sections. Extend from K-injective representatives by naturality. The given quasi-compactness hypotheses remain unchanged and no properness or density is used.

mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q137-5ca5e9e5d (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: FIX: I read the item, both new nodes, every cited statement, the repair note, blueprint det-sf-comp-coherence-cocycle.proof.md (Refinement isomorphisms l.13-18, Independence l.24-36) and Stacks 0D6G/070I/08BJ. The re-split note is met. There are 2 new nodes of comparable size: lem-sfb-identity-open-module-sections (A, geometric) and lem-sfb-exact-postcomposition-kinjective-descent (B, abstract). Each of the six old steps went to A, to B or to a citation, and none was dropped. The parent is a 4-step assembly. Statement and stmt_deps are unchanged against the landed N0/N9 state, the item is not dropped, and nothing cites SGA.

A is true. Since h p2 = j v p1, p2 lands in j'(U), so (1,j'v) is the inverse of the projection. Composition via the associator and identity both check, and A holds for any commutative condensed ring, including the l-adic Qbar_l. The preimage hypothesis is needed: the fold map U⊔U→U is a counterexample without it.

B is true. r_c is Q(c_I) composed with the inverse of D(E0)(gamma_I) on K-injectives, and it is unique. In the composition clause, JI is K-injective by 08BJ and Q(c'_I)Q(c_JI)Q(E0 d_I) = Q(b_I).

Neither node duplicates an existing one. I compared them with def-sfb-identity-open-restriction-arrows, the open-square mates, module-direct-image-open-pasting, kinjective-direct-image-open-word-model (needs alpha invertible for every letter), kinjective-exact-square-comparison (strict sH'=Hr) and the normalized-derived-comparison family.

I fixed two faults in the parent:
(1) Step 3 did not name E2=j''^*, c'=c_k, b=c_hk, and did not cite the exact left adjoint (hk)^* or the resolutions on Z''. I added these, with det-prop-sfb-module-pullback-exact-main.
(2) Step 4 used B's identity clause, which needs H=1 literally, but here H=(1_Z)_*. It now derives r_1 = D(j^*)iota^d from B's uniqueness clause and the identity comparison of compositor-coherence.
The new proof is 2973 characters. The fix is a whole-node file at fixes/dag/nodes/sec-six-functors-basics/lem-sfb-identity-open-derived-restriction.json.
